text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli army, Palestinian Authority probe riot death. Israeli army and police on high alert for Land Day.
- Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejects "make-believe peace".
- Canadian-Jewish groups clash over "Nazi snitch line".
- U.S. President Bill Clinton drafts "new and aggressive" peace initiative between Israel and Palestinians that includes an end to Jewish settlements and a war on terrorism with U.S. participation.
- Israel's Shin Bet security chief Ami Ayalon supposed to meet soon with heads of the Palestinian security apparatus.
- Netanyahu: No one has authority to force chairman of Africa-Israel to desecrate Jewish sabbath and run shopping mall.
- Land Day: Record tension after Palestinian killed during demonstration.
- Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai will ask Americans for additional financing for Arrow anti-missile missile.
